blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein unknown \(n\) do combinations ka upar wala number hai, aur dono combinations barabar diye gaye hain.
Diya kya hai? \({}^{n}C_{6} = {}^{n}C_{2}\). Find kya karna hai? \(n\).
Plan: complementary combinations ka rule: agar \({}^{n}C_{x} = {}^{n}C_{y}\) ho to ya \(x = y\), ya \(x + y = n\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{n}C_{6} = {}^{n}C_{2}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: Section 7.4.2 ka theorem \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\). Is ka matlab: \(n\) cheezon mein se \(r\) chunna aur \(n - r\) chhorna ek hi kaam hai. Is liye agar do combinations barabar hon aur upar ka number ek hi ho, to neeche ke number ya barabar hote hain ya un ka jama \(n\) hota hai.

Rule lagayein
\[6 \ne 2\]
\[\Rightarrow 6 + 2 = n\]
\[n = 8\]
Kyun: 6 aur 2 barabar nahi, is liye pehli surat (barabar hona) khatam. Doosri surat bachi: dono complementary hain, yani \(2 = n - 6\), jis se \(n = 8\).
Dhyan dein: Kuch students \(6 = 2\) wali surat ko bhool kar seedha cross multiply karne lagte hain; is rule se sawal ek line ka ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{8}C_{6} = {}^{8}C_{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7}{2} = 28\]
Kyun: Dono sides 28 deti hain. 8 dosto mein se 6 ko trip par le jana aur 2 ko chhor dena ek hi faisla hai, is liye ginti barabar hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan right side abhi combination ki shakal mein nahi likhi hui, bas ek fraction hai.
Diya kya hai? \({}^{n}C_{11} = \frac{14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12}{3!}\). Find kya karna hai? \(n\).
Plan: pehle pehchanein ke right side \({}^{14}C_{3}\) hai, phir complementary rule se use \({}^{14}C_{11}\) banayein, aur aakhir mein dono sides compare karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{n}C_{11} = \frac{14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12}{3!}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r}\) ka shortcut yeh hai: \(n\) se neeche ki taraf \(r\) numbers multiply karein aur \(r!\) se divide karein. Is shortcut ko ulta parhein to right side pehchani ja sakti hai. Phir \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\) lagayenge.

Right side ko pehchanein
\[\dfrac{14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12}{3!} = {}^{14}C_{3}\]
Kyun: Upar 14 se shuru ho kar teen numbers neeche ki taraf hain (14, 13, 12) aur neeche \(3!\) hai. Yeh bilkul \({}^{14}C_{3}\) ka shortcut hai: \(n = 14\), \(r = 3\).

Complementary rule lagayein
\[{}^{14}C_{3} = {}^{14}C_{14-3}\]
\[= {}^{14}C_{11}\]
Kyun: Left side mein neeche 11 hai, lekin right side mein 3. In ko milane ke liye \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\) lagaya: 14 mein se 3 chunna aur 11 chunna barabar hai, kyunke \(3 + 11 = 14\).

Compare karein
\[{}^{n}C_{11} = {}^{14}C_{11}\]
\[n = 14\]
Kyun: Ab dono taraf neeche 11 hai, is liye upar ke numbers bhi barabar hone chahiye. \(n \ge 11\) ke liye \({}^{n}C_{11}\) \(n\) barhne ke saath barhta hi jata hai, is liye koi doosra \(n\) yeh value nahi de sakta.
Dhyan dein: Jaldi mein \(n = 14\) ki jagah \(r\) wale numbers (3 ya 11) ko jawab na likh dein.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12}{6} = \dfrac{2184}{6} = 364\]
\[{}^{14}C_{11} = {}^{14}C_{3} = 364 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides ka number 364 hai, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul part (i) jaisa sawal hai: do combinations barabar hain aur dono ka upar wala number \(n\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \({}^{n}C_{5} = {}^{n}C_{10}\). Find kya karna hai? \(n\).
Plan: 5 aur 10 barabar nahi, is liye un ka jama \(n\) hoga.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{n}C_{5} = {}^{n}C_{10}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: Agar \({}^{n}C_{x} = {}^{n}C_{y}\) ho to \(x = y\) ya \(x + y = n\). Yeh rule \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\) se nikalta hai: \(n\) cheezon mein se 5 chunna aur 10 chunna tabhi barabar hai jab 5 chunne ka matlab 10 chhorna ho.

Rule lagayein
\[5 \ne 10\]
\[\Rightarrow n = 5 + 10 = 15\]
Kyun: Neeche ke numbers barabar nahi, is liye woh complementary hain: \(10 = n - 5\), yani \(n = 15\). 15 cheezon mein se 5 utha lein to baqi 10 khud ba khud chhut jati hain.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{15}C_{10} = {}^{15}C_{5}\]
\[= \dfrac{15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11}{120}\]
\[= 3003\]
Kyun: Dono taraf ek hi number 3003 aata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(n\) hamesha neeche wale dono numbers se bara ya barabar hona chahiye; 15 dono (5 aur 10) se bara hai, is liye yeh jawab mumkin bhi hai.
